Question ID: JOUR_U06_L03_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.JOUR.NEWS.04

Source: Writing Package Revision. Task: The student newsroom is preparing a final article package about the spring club fair. Draft Problem: The article begins with a strong quote, but the second paragraph jumps to a list of clubs without explaining why the fair matters. Feedback: The editor says the article needs clearer purpose, stronger transitions, one sentence of evidence from attendance numbers, and corrected capitalization for club names. Available Evidence: last year had 18 clubs; this year has 27 clubs; student council says the fair was moved to the gym so more students could attend. Publication Need: The article must be clear, cohesive, accurate, and convention-ready before it appears in the final portfolio. Question: Which decision best matches the lesson standard?
